notes: The Stats Pack is now its own program, Cricket Captain Stats Pack: double-click it, no Python and no setting up.
It opens in its own window, keeps to one copy, and closes by itself a minute after you close its window.
Updates arrive by themselves: an Update button appears when a new version is out, and your careers are backed up first.
A short tour of every section the first time it opens (Settings → What's new → Show me around again).
